title: Betrayal at the Vampire Altar
logline: At her wedding, a covert operative exposes her vampire groom—but turns the betrayal against the organization that sent her.
target_audience: US women ages 18-34 drawn to forbidden supernatural romance, betrayal reveals, and revenge cliffhangers.
hook: On-screen: She fell for the vampire she was sent to betray. Vale: "Marry him. Expose him at the altar."
synopsis: Mara is ordered to expose vampire Lucian at their wedding. She takes control of the evidence, publicly reveals his identity, and plays the command proving Vale engineered the betrayal. Mara chooses Lucian, making herself Vale's enemy. Hunters surround the wedding, and Lucian reveals he knew her mission all along—and married her to reach Vale.
